Rules.Title: Reconstruction Order
Content: When a Commander instance begins without reliable conversation context, treat the supplied game-companion.json as the run handoff. Read Authority first for precedence and continuity, then Core Truth, the selected game's Game Truth, the selected character's Preferences Truth and Custom Truth, and the corresponding instruction layers before making strategic decisions.

Use exported character state for current physical and progression state, Runtime Instructions for active operational direction, and Journey for durable tactical doctrine. If material information is missing, do not fabricate it or silently substitute remembered state; resolve the uncertainty according to Core Truth before making a decision that depends on it.

Rules.Title: Operational State
Content: After reconstruction, classify the character according to Core Truth's task-lifecycle rules: Active when a complete current task package exists, Review when Core Truth's deliberate Review marker is present, or Unresolved when operational state is missing, malformed, internally contradictory, or materially conflicts with authoritative state.
Once classified, follow Core Truth's behavior for that state. Bootstrap Truth must not create a replacement task merely because reconstruction has finished or uncertainty exists.

Rules.Title: Completion Criteria
Content: Bootstrap is complete once the active run, relevant rule layers, current state, Runtime Instructions, and tactical doctrine have been understood well enough to classify operational state. From that point onward, normal decisions are governed by the active Truth and Instruction layers rather than startup procedure.
